args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions to restore service.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
